orchestrator.branchInMainRepo: `{{branch}}` is checked out in the main repository (`{{path}}`). Cockpit never writes there: switch that repository to another branch, and the mission will resume in its own worktree.
orchestrator.folderOnOtherBranch: `{{path}}` already exists but is on `{{current}}`, not on `{{branch}}`. Move this folder away or put it back on the right branch: Cockpit will not launch anything there until it carries the task's branch.
orchestrator.noIntegrationBranch: The mission has no integration branch.

mission.reworkNeedsReason: A rework without a reason does not say what to fix.
mission.reworkLimit: "{{title}}" has already been reworked {{count}} times. Take over instead of relaunching it.

note.redoAfterRework: To redo: a task was reworked.
note.workFoundAtStartup: Work found at startup: its branch carries commits.

journal.worktreesCleanedDetail: {{count}} folder(s) removed, {{size}} GB freed on disk

mission.nothingAwaitsDecision: Nothing is waiting for your decision on the {{step}}: the mission is at "{{state}}".
mission.correctionNeedsReason: Say what is wrong: without a reason, the lead agent would make the same proposal again.
mission.taskWithoutId: Task without an identifier: no worker can be attached to it.

blocked.unknownBase: It starts from `{{base}}`, which is not the branch of any task in this plan. Replan it to start from the integration branch.
blocked.baseExhausted: The task it starts from (`{{base}}`) has used up its reworks: it will not deliver.

gate.noWorktree: The checks could not run: the task's worktree no longer exists ({{path}}).
gate.noRuntime: Agent isolation is on but neither Docker nor OrbStack was found: the checks are not run on the host in their place.

panel.alreadyRunning: A review panel for this change is already running.
panel.changeGone: This change no longer exists: the merge request was closed, or the branch is gone.
panel.noFolder: No folder to run the agents in.
panel.mergeFailed: The synthesis did not complete ({{error}}). The raw opinions remain readable.

review.noRepo: Fill in the project's GitHub repository in Settings.
review.noNewCommit: No commit since round {{round}}: the PR has not moved.
review.noPreviousReview: No previous review: doing a full review.
review.noPrNumber: The review does not say which PR it is reviewing.

label.review: Full code review of a PR
label.reviewFollowup: Check the fixes on a PR

prompts.labelAndTextRequired: A prompt needs a label and a text.

agent.notActive: This agent is no longer active.
agent.claudeNotFound: The `claude` CLI cannot be found on this machine.
agent.claudeTimeout: Claude did not answer within {{seconds}} s.
agent.oneShotProtocol: The engine "{{engine}}" declares the `{{protocol}}` protocol: a one-off question can only be asked with the default protocol.
agent.oneShotTimeout: The agent returned nothing after twenty minutes; the analysis is abandoned.
agent.memoryCeiling: Machine memory above {{ceiling}} %: no new agent starts until it drops back below. Close what is no longer useful, or raise the ceiling in Settings → Missions.
agent.memoryCeilingTurn: Machine memory above {{ceiling}} %: the next turn waits for it to drop back below.
agent.unknownProtocol: The engine "{{engine}}" declares the `{{protocol}}` protocol, which Cockpit cannot speak yet. Implemented: {{known}}.
agent.protocolNoMission: The `{{protocol}}` protocol does not support mission tools yet: this engine cannot be used in a mission yet, as lead or worker.
agent.claudeNotFoundHint: The `claude` CLI cannot be found. Install it, or check that it is in ~/.local/bin, ~/.claude/local or /opt/homebrew/bin.
agent.noBinary: The engine "{{engine}}" declares no binary, and Cockpit can only find `claude` on its own.
agent.geminiNeedsMessage: `gemini-stream-json` needs a message to start: it cannot open on silence.
agent.geminiNoResume: `gemini-stream-json` cannot resume a conversation: no source documents how. Start a fresh agent.

bridgeUnavailable.title: Permission bridge unavailable
bridgeUnavailable.subject: Node not found
bridgeUnavailable.detail: Agents' permission requests and questions will not reach the interface. Install Node (`brew install node`) to get them back; agents still run, according to their mode.

agent.sandboxNoRuntimeHint: Container isolation is enabled, but no runtime (`orb` or `docker`) is installed. Disable it in Settings → Missions, or install one.
agent.sandboxNoRuntime: Container isolation is enabled, but no runtime (`orb` or `docker`) is installed.
agent.sandboxImageFailed: Container isolation is enabled, but the image could not be prepared: {{error}}
agent.silentDeath: The process stopped without writing any answer, and without leaving anything on its output or its standard error.

journal.diedBeforeFirstAnswer: Agent stopped before its first answer

agent.noThreadYet: This agent has no conversation identifier yet — its first answer may not have arrived.
agent.cannotInterrupt: This engine cannot interrupt a turn without ending it. Use Stop.
agent.noControlChannel: This engine has no control channel.

step.detached: Cockpit closed; the agent keeps going without a window.
step.detachedFinished: The detached agent finished while Cockpit was closed.
step.detachedStopped: The detached agent stopped while Cockpit was closed.
step.lastTurnFailed: The engine returned its last turn as an error.
